finding: Hypothesis H34 independent audit reveals: 1. Candidate C4 Direct (Package 115) and Candidate C4 Sequential Continuation (Package 113) are fundamentally non-comparable reference states: Package 113 is an incremental forward continuation (Frames 77->78->79) with 1,640 clamped nodes, while Package 115 is a static direct transfer at Frame 79 with only 110 clamped nodes. 2. Total energy difference between Sequential and Direct C4 states is -46.27 nJ (-0.0213%), which exceeds H33's fine-mesh truncation estimate of 20.58 nJ by 2.25x. 3. Crucially, an elastic-fracture energy compensation of 1.504 uJ (98.4% cancellation) masks a major disparity in crack state: Package 113 has +1.458 uJ (+0.85%) higher elastic energy and -1.504 uJ (-3.30%) lower fracture energy, accompanied by -4.69% lower peak damage (0.4992 vs 0.5238) and +1.603 N (+0.86%) stiffer reaction force. 4. While coarse C3 under-resolves AT2 fracture gradients (+11.1% shift in direct transfer), scalar total-energy uncertainty overlap alone does NOT establish physical transfer correctness. Consequently, transfer error is NOT excluded (H34_TRANSFER_ERROR_NOT_EXCLUDED). In accordance with governance rules, submission of an artificial HPC job is WITHHELD. The governing gate STAGE_C1_2_STEP2_ENERGY_GATE_FAILED and classification P113_GATE_VALID_FAILURE remain strictly retained.
